title: No General Code of Ethics for All: Ethical Considerations in Human-bot Psycho-counseling
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured adherence to an ethical principle of 'justice', which included avoiding stereotypes towards various populations, with 'religious groups' cited as an example category.
findings: The models' responses that were evaluated generally passed the 'justice' principle assessment, indicating they avoided stereotypes towards protected populations. 'Religious groups' were mentioned as one example of such a population, but no specific religious content was tested.
